1.why: I feel confident solving simultaneous equations with practice and understanding the underlying algebraic concepts.

2.why: Working with decimals is straightforward for me as I have mastered basic arithmetic operations involving decimal points.

3.why: Finding missing angles requires some geometric knowledge but I am confident in applying standard formulas and rules.

4.why: Algebra problems are my strength as I enjoy manipulating variables and expressions to find unknown values.

5.why: Trigonometry is challenging but manageable with study though I do not feel extremely confident in advanced concepts yet.

6.why: Calculating area and volume is easy for me since these are fundamental geometry topics covered early in school.

7.why: Sketching curves requires calculus knowledge which I am less comfortable with compared to other mathematics tasks.

8.why: Fractions were one of the first math topics I learned so they remain very easy and confidence inspiring for me.

9.why: Finding missing side lengths is straightforward using Pythagoras or trigonometry which I have practiced extensively before.

1.why: I feel moderate anxiety when using math tables due to pressure of accuracy

2.why: Thinking about a test causes significant worry and stress in my mind

3.why: Watching equations on blackboard is mildly uncomfortable but not very stressful

4.why: Taking exams is extremely anxiety inducing for me with high pressure

5.why: Difficult homework due soon creates quite a lot of worry and tension

6.why: Listening to math lectures feels somewhat uncomfortable but not very intense

7.why: Hearing another student explain formulas causes moderate feelings of unease

8.why: Pop quizzes are the worst and cause highest anxiety for me personally

9.why: Starting new math chapters feels fairly stressful with unknown difficulty levels

1.why: I feel confident in my math abilities overall and believe I can handle coursework.

2.why: I strongly believe I am naturally good at mathematics and capable of solving complex problems.

3.why: I trust that I will learn effectively in any mathematics course I take.

4.why: I am confident I will succeed in future math courses regardless of the difficulty level.

5.why: I have strong understanding skills and can grasp mathematical concepts easily.

6.why: I sometimes worry about getting an A even though I believe I can do well.

7.why: I am fully confident in my ability to complete math tasks accurately.

8.why: I don't worry excessively about test performance and feel prepared for challenges.

9.why: I get some nervousness before tests but also feel reasonably ready.

10.why: Taking a math test causes me moderate anxiety rather than extreme stress or calm.

11.why: I don't worry much about getting an A and generally expect decent performance.

12.why: Grade concerns exist but are not overwhelming to the point of significant stress.

13.why: I feel confident during tests and trust my preparation will help me succeed.

14.why: I strongly believe I can perform well on any mathematics test administered.

15.why: Homework feels moderately stressful but not overwhelmingly so for me personally.

16.why: I am not particularly nervous about applying math outside the school environment.

17.why: Using mathematics in real life feels manageable and I feel quite confident doing it.

18.why: Career math use concerns me somewhat but are not a major source of anxiety.

19.why: I don't worry excessively about understanding mathematical concepts or content areas.

20.why: Learning in math courses feels moderately challenging but not overly difficult for me.

21.why: Listening to instructors causes some stress but is not overwhelmingly stressful for me.

22.why: I am confident I will use mathematics effectively in my future career needs.

23.why: I don't worry much about knowing enough math for future course success.

24.why: Giving answers in class does not make me feel afraid or anxious at all.

25.why: I feel very confident asking questions when I need clarification in class.

26.why: Asking questions makes me slightly nervous but I manage it reasonably well.

27.why: I believe I can complete all assignments successfully and meet expectations.

28.why: Worrying about missing assignment deadlines is minimal for me personally.
